{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the data with proper parsing
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Fix revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop refunded orders
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] != 'refunded']

# Compute conversion rate within each customer segment
conversion_by_segment_channel = sales_df.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute the difference in conversion rate (email - paid_search) within each segment
conversion_diff = conversion_by_segment_channel['email'] - conversion_by_segment_channel['paid_search']

# Check if the email campaign underperformed in all segments
underperformed = (conversion_diff < 0).all()

# Compute the average conversion rate difference across segments
avg_diff = conversion_diff.mean()

# Return results
(underperformed, avg_diff, conversion_diff)"}
